votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the consent calendar as presented, tabling 3e, and noting the clerical error in the minutes.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve a $2,000 sponsorship to the Boys and Girls Club of Southern Utah for their First Annual Golf Tournament fundraiser.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve the amendments to the Fiscal Year 2023-2024 Budget.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2023-021 amending City code regarding camping in public places.

A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to deny Ordinance No. 2023-022 amending the City Zoning Map by amending the zone from R-1-10 (Single Family 10,000 square foot minimum lot size) to R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) on approximately 0.29 acres generally located at 151 Sir Monte Drive for the purpose of creating consistent zoning on this split-zoned parcel, adding that the applicant return with a PD-R zone to consider at that time.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2023-023 amending an approved PD-C (Planned Development Commercial) on approximately 1.36 acres, located at approximately 2700 East Mall Drive for the purpose of adding a 10,000 square foot retail building for a project to be known as Walgreens, and amending the use list on the larger 5.17 acre, lot 5 of Fields at Mall Drive Phase 2, with conditions from the Planning Commission that include the cross access easement with Revere Health for lot 5.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2023-024 amending an approved PD-R (Planned Development Residential) on approximately 10.01 acres located at 800 West Tonaquint Drive for the purpose of developing 89 townhomes for a project to be known as Tonaquint Townhomes.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to approve the preliminary plat for the Tonaquint Townhomes, an 89-unit townhome project located 800 West Tonaquint Drive.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2023-025 amending the existing Grand View Planned Development Residential (PD-R) zone on approximately 20.61 acres to amend the approved Grand View Townhomes with conceptual site plan, landscape plans, materials, and elevations, located generally between Canyon View Drive and Skyrocket Road west of Dixie Drive to be known as Grand View Townhomes with conditions from the Planning Commission and staff.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve the preliminary plat for the Grand View Townhomes, a 112-unit townhome project located generally between Canyon View Drive and Skyrocket Road.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember McArthur to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
